text_block_list.text:
Once again this year, the summer training 
camp to improve the Umamusume's skills has 
arrived.
choice_data_list:
I look forward to working with you again 
this year!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"The pleasure is all mine, I look forward 
to working with you ♪"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: "We're even more fired up than last year!"

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>'s brilliance only continues to grow 
brighter by the day.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"As your Trainer, I shall raise you with 
everything I've got!"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: —St Lite-san, Haiseiko-kun.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The crape myrtle planted last year seems 
to be blooming nicely. The students were 
delighted.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Yay, that's so nice♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if anyone will notice the 
uplifting playlist I hid on the cassette 
tape by the shore..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah-wah~~?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
G-G-G-G, Grass-chan! In the fridge, 
there's iiiiiice cream--!! We've got it 
again this year too--!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And on top of that... Whoaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Besides milk, there's cheese, yogurt... So 
many new flavors~!!

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho. It seems my surprise has been 
uncovered.
choice_data_list: Um, what on earth are you...?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Seeing everyone's hard work up close last 
year... I wondered if there was something 
more I could do besides just giving 
advice!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The three of us thought about what we 
would have wanted back then.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I prepared all kinds of surprises. Seems 
the reception has been quite favorable."
choice_data_list: Everyone is so kind, aren't they...!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: No, it's more like—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah! Hello, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Speed Symboli-san! Please tell me more 
about European food sometime!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Um, Saint Lite-sama... I'd like to learn a 
bit more about how to carry myself in 
public... I'll gather my questions and 
come back!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Haiseiko-san! I mastered some totally 
emotional steps! Please watch me next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Well then, excuse me~!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, you understand, right?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: My juniors... are just so darn adorable.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: "...Now then. Shall we be on our way?"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a message from St Lite-san! That's 
rare~!

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Once I have made up my mind, I never stray 
from my path.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Before everyone's training begins, I'll do 
a bit of running.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
We're Umamusume too, after all. Seeing 
everyone working so hard makes you want to 
get moving yourself.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It probably won't be like back in my 
active days, but I intend to do everything 
I can.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hey, St. Lite-san.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
I've had a longer hiatus than either of 
you, so... Please go easy on me.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it our all! Well then, I'm 
heading out!

It seems that through the "Dream Fest," a 
change is taking place within the legends 
as well.

"They're sure to offer new insights. Let's 
learn even more from them... and turn that 
into growth for <chrname>!"
